node.statement: Node 1.5 verifies every antecedent of lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation for D=D_*, t=t_1, epsilon_R=epsilon, B_R=C^{m+1}, A_R=A, and u_R=u_1. Substituting these values into the verbatim conclusion of that external yields only the error-improved map v_1, the inequality d_1<=W.c0_cb*epsilon, the displayed unit estimate, and preservation of source, target corner, and amplification form. Since def-maincb-reset-state makes the inclusion/isomorphism tag separately supplied data and def-maincb-raw-call says a recorded defect number asserts no inclusion property, these outputs cannot be strengthened to an extended d_1-inclusion without an additional permitted lemma.
